english: Maize plants grow tall, thin, and weak when planted too close together or when they lack sufficient phosphorus and potassium in the soil. Giving each plant enough space allows sunlight to reach them, and balanced fertilizer helps them build thick stalks capable of supporting heavy cobs.
ga: Abɛi daa, egbɔjɔɔ ni egbɔjɔɔ kɛji akɛ adu lɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ he tsɔ loo kɛji akɛ phosphorus kɛ potassium ni fa bɔ ni sa bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Ni aha tso fɛɛ tso he ko ni fa bɔ ni sa koni hulu la ashɛ ehe. Ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni ja lɛ baaye abua ni tsei lɛ aná ŋmeii ni mli tse ni baanyɛ akwɛ ŋmeii ni tsii lɛ anɔ.

english: Why do my pepper plant leaves curl up like spoons during the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ shi tamɔ spun yɛ shwane mli lɛ?

english: Leaf curling in peppers is often a sign of water stress or tiny sucking pests like aphids and thrips on the underside of the leaves. Supplying water and using a safe insecticidal chemical stops the pests and helps the leaves open up normally.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni shwieɔ shi yɛ ŋmɔtɔ mli lɛ ji nu he haomɔ loo kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ aphids kɛ thrips ni yɔɔ baai lɛ ashishi lɛ he okadi. Nu ni akɛhaa kɛ tsofai ni gbeɔ kooloi ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ baaha kooloi lɛ akpa ni eye ebua baa lɛ ni egbele bɔ ni sa.

english: Does using chemical fertilizer every season ruin the soil on my farm?
ga: Ani tsofai ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii daa be lɛ fiteɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Relying strictly on chemical fertilizers without adding organic materials like manure or compost can make soil hard and acidic over time. Combining correct chemical fertilizer applications with organic matter keeps the soil rich, moist, and productive for years.
ga: Tsofai ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli ni akɛtsuɔ nii waa ni akɛ nibii ni wala yɔɔ mli tamɔ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii fataaa he. Enɛ baanyɛ aha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee shiŋŋ ni efee acid yɛ be ni sa mli. Kɛ akɛ tsofai ni sa ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli nibii amli lɛ tsu nii kɛfata nibii ni wala yɔɔ mli ahe lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni shikpɔŋ lɛ afee ŋmɔshi nibii, ni efee ŋmɔtɔ ni ewo yibii afii babaoo ni baa lɛ.

english: How can I tell if my farmland soil has enough plant food to start planting crops?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ tsei niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ mabɔi tsei akwɛmɔ?

english: Healthy, fertile soil is usually dark brown or black, crumbles easily in your hand, holds moisture well, and supports natural weed growth or earthworms. A soil test from an extension officer will give you exact details on what nutrients your farm soil is missing before you plant.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ nii, ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔtɔ loo ediŋŋ. Efoɔ oya yɛ oniji amli Ehaa ŋmɔtɔ hiɔ shi jogbaŋŋ ni eyeɔ ebuaa adebɔɔ mli jwɛi loo shikpɔŋ nɔ ŋmeii ni daraa lɛ. Shikpɔŋ nɔ kaa ni jɛ extension nitsulɔ ko ŋɔɔ lɛ baatsɔɔ niyenii kpakpai ni bɛ oŋmɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ mli fitsofitso dani odu.

english: Yellow leaves on young maize usually mean the crop is lacking nitrogen, which is the main nutrient plants need to grow healthy green leaves. Adding well-rotted manure or nitrogen fertilizer restores their green color.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa bibii anɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. Enɛ ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛná baai eŋɔli ni mli wa. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, ebaaha ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ afee ŋmɔŋ ekoŋŋ.

english: Why do the leaves on my pepper plants curl up and twist tightly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ ebɔle ehe ni ebɔle ehe waa lɛ?

english: Pepper leaves curl when tiny sap-sucking pests like aphids or thrips feed on the undersides of young leaves. Spraying with a mild soap solution or neem oil controls these insects so new leaves can grow normally.
ga: Pepper baai lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛji kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ aphids loo thrips yeɔ baai bibii lɛ ashishi. Kɛ́ akɛ nu ni mli ejɔ Loo neem fɔ shwie nɔ lɛ, ebaakudɔ kooloi nɛɛ koni baai heei anyɛ akwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why are my cassava roots rotting in the soil before I dig them up?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli dani mifoɔ amɛ lɛ?

english: Cassava roots rot when water collects and stays around them in heavy or poorly drained soil. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges lets excess rainwater flow away, keeping the roots dry and healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu bua amɛhe naa ni ebɔle amɛhe. Cassava shishifãi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni tsii loo shikpɔŋ ni nu hoɔ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ Cassava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkpɔi ni nɔ kwɔlɔ anɔ lɛ baaha nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ atsɔ mli. Ehaa shishifãi lɛ gĩɔ ni amɛhe wa

english: Young cocoa seedlings have tender leaves that burn under harsh, direct sunlight. Leaving large trees or planting plantains alongside cocoa creates shade and keeps the air cool and humid, protecting the young plants.
ga: Kookoo dumɔwui bibii lɛ yɛ baai bibii ni shãa yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Tsei wuji ni ashiɔ loo dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ kookoo masɛi lɛ haa hulutsoo baa, ni ehaa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli jɔɔ ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ baa. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ebuɔ tsei bibii ahe

english: Tomato flowers fall off when temperatures get extremely hot or when the plant experiences water stress. Irrigating regularly and applying mulch around the base keeps the root zone cool and hydrated so flowers can form fruits.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔii lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa waa loo kɛ́ tsei lɛ na nu he haomɔ. Nu daa ni okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii abɔle he. Shishitoo lɛ haa shishifã lɛ he lɛ feɔ fɛ̃i ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ baa. koni fɔfɔi lɛ awo yibii

english: Why do my yam tubers grow into strange, crooked shapes instead of growing straight?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ daa yɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ amli lɛ? Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeetsɔ tɛ̃ɛ?

english: Yam tubers become bent or twisted when the soil below them is hard, rocky, or compacted. Tilling the land deeply and creating high, loose soil mounds allows the tubers to push down smoothly and grow straight.
ga: Sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ baabɔle loo amɛbaatsake kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amɛshishi lɛ mli wa, tɛi yɔɔ mli, loo eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni mli kwɔ ni afee gɔŋ ni nɔ kwɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ haa ŋmeii lɛ tsiɔ amɛhe kɛyaa shi mlɛo ni amɛdaraa tɛ̃ɛ.
